acts.title: Aigul, in three tenses
text: I was born in Taraz in 1994 and I grew up there. My parents weren’t rich, but they were happy.
I studied engineering in Almaty from 2012 to 2016. My first job was in a small company and it was terrible.
Now I work freelance from home. I usually start at eight and I hardly ever work after six.
I go to the gym twice a week and I never work at the weekend.
Last summer I went to Georgia with my sister. We didn’t see Tbilisi, but the mountains were beautiful.

write.q: Put Units 1–3 together: write 8 sentences. Where you were born and grew up, what your first job was, what you do now, how often you do two things, one person in your family, and where you went last summer.
write.model: I was born in Karaganda in 1996 and I grew up there. My parents weren’t rich, but we were happy. I studied engineering in Almaty and my first job was in a small company — it was terrible. Now I work freelance from home. I always start at eight and I hardly ever work after six. I go to the gym twice a week. My sister’s daughter is my niece; she’s three. Last summer I went to Georgia, but I didn’t see Tbilisi.

speak.q: Interview a partner out loud with six questions — three about the past and three about now. Then answer the same six about yourself.
speak.model: Where were you born? Where did you go last summer? What was your first job? — What do you do now? How often do you travel? Does your company have an office here? — I was born in Karaganda. Last summer I went to Georgia. My first job was in a shop. I’m an engineer, I travel once a month, and no, we all work from home.
